units.source_text: “这也是作为股东，作为资本家所必须的嘛。

en.t: This too is something required of you as a shareholder, as a capitalist.

units.source_text: 你将成为烧毁的造纸公司的社长。

en.t: You will become the president of the paper company that burned down.

units.source_text: 站在资本家的立场上，解救一下失业职工的问题可以吧？”

en.t: From the standpoint of a capitalist, it would be all right to help resolve the problem of the unemployed workers, wouldn't it?
